note: Picks by level, in our own words. Every fact here is from the game files (via maplestory.io) or the MapleStory Classic Wiki. Map stats on the page come from the same data and update daily.

tips: Do the Maple Island quests before you sail: together they pay more than the 300 mesos Shanks charges for the boat to Lith Harbor.

picks.why: Ribbon Pigs (21 of 73 spawn points) with snails, pigs and mushrooms. One level 28 Iron Hog also spawns here.
The Slime tree north of Ellinia: 70 spawn points, every monster level 11 or lower.
Slimes and mushrooms, two maps past Henesys Hunting Ground I.

tips: Pick maps where you kill in one or two hits; extra hits are where potions go.

picks.map: Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North IV
picks.why: Green Mushrooms and Slimes in the Ellinia tree dungeons. Green Mushrooms drop 28 to 35 mesos on about 68% of kills (wiki, 620 kills).
Octopus near Kerning City.

tips: Stay off Dangerous Croko I and II: level 52 Crocos walk through them.

picks.why: Bubblings under Kerning City: 64 spawn points, weak to lightning. The Grand Launch lowered its monster rate from 0.9 to 0.8.
Stirges (level 20): 38 spawn points.
38 Stirge spawn points with a few Horny and Zombie Mushrooms.
Jr. Neckis (level 21) and Octopus: 11 and 15 spawn points.

tips: Kerning PQ (First Time Together): level 21+, 30 minutes. A full run gives 1,234 EXP at level 21 and 3,000 from level 30.
Iron Hogs have 500 weapon defense but 100 magic defense, and are weak to lightning.

picks.why: 61 Zombie Mushroom and 38 Horny Mushroom spawn points, three maps from Sleepywood. Zombie Mushrooms are undead.
The 24 Hr Mobile Store on the map sells Fried Chicken, Pizza, Unagi, Cake and Pure Water.
Ant Tunnel with Evil Eyes mixed in.
Stirges with mushrooms.

picks.map: The Land of Wild Boar II
picks.why: 23 Wild Boar spawn points (level 25) near Perion.

tips: Jr. Wraiths (level 34) need about 82 accuracy to hit every time at level 34, about 95 at level 30, by the site's hit formula.

picks.why: Jr. Wraiths under Kerning City: 83 of 97 spawn points, the most of any map for the range. They are undead, so Heal hurts them.
Fire Boars: weak to ice, resist fire.
Lorangs (level 38), weak to lightning.
Ligators (level 31) with Horny Mushrooms and Jr. Neckis: 79 spawn points. Ligators are weak to fire and resist ice.

picks.map: A Look-Out Shed Around the Beach
picks.why: Lorangs (level 38), weak to lightning, with Lupins. One portal from Florina Beach.

tips: Line 2 (Area 3) is six maps from Kerning City: carry potions.

picks.why: Zombie Lupins (level 41): undead, 0 weapon defense. Heal hurts them.
68 Wraith spawn points (level 48). Wraiths are undead.
Copper Drakes (level 45) and Fire Boars: both weak to ice, both resist fire.
Torties (level 46) with Clangs. Clangs are weak to lightning.
107 spawn points under Kerning City: 57 Wraiths, 32 Jr. Wraiths and 18 Jr. Neckis.

picks.map: The Tunnel That Lost Light I
picks.why: Cold Eyes (level 40) and Drakes (level 50), 15 maps from Sleepywood. Cold Eyes are weak to fire; Drakes resist fire and ice.
Skeledogs (level 44) and Mummydogs (47), both undead. Part of the Excavation Site, added at the Grand Launch on 21 October 2026.

tips: Sleepy Dungeon V: the Grand Launch lowered its monster rate setting from 0.6 to 0.4.

picks.why: Maladies (level 55) and Zombie Lupins. Maladies resist fire and ice and are weak to holy.
68 Wraith spawn points, the most of any map around level 48.
Clangs (level 49) and Lorangs (38), both weak to lightning.
Crocos (level 52), weak to fire, resist ice: about 101 accuracy hits every time at level 52, 109 at 50. Crocos are 24 of 54 spawn points; the rest are Jr. Neckis and Slimes.
Stone Golems (level 56): 10 of 23 spawn points. The Golem's Temple maps are among the smallest with monsters.

tips: Several maps here respawn slowly (wiki): Wild Kargos and Tauromacis every 120 s, Red Drakes every 20 to 60 s.

picks.why: 14 Wild Kargo spawn points (level 62) among 17 Cold Eyes. About 117 accuracy hits every time at level 62, 135 at 58.
17 Red Drake spawn points (level 60) with Copper Drakes and Fire Boars. Red Drakes are weak to ice.
4 Tauromacis (level 70) among 13 Cold Eyes. Taurospears start at Sanctuary Entrance III.

economy: NPC HP food costs half a meso per HP: Apple, Egg, Red Potion, Fried Chicken and Meat. MP costs one meso per MP: Orange and Lemon.
Cake restores 100 HP and 100 MP for 150 mesos, the same as Red Potions and Oranges. Only the 24 Hr Mobile Store in Ant Tunnel Park sells it.
White Potions cost 0.7 mesos per HP and Blue Potions 1.1 per MP.
Citizenship from level 12 (Henesys or Kerning City) opens the town hall shops: Supreme Sniper Potions in Henesys, Wolbi Throwing Stars in Kerning City.
Magicians: 3 points in Magic Guard unlock Magic Armor.
Ice-weak: Fire Boar, Copper Drake, Red Drake, Tauromacis. Ice-resistant: Ligator, Cold Eye, Drake, Croco. Lightning-weak: Iron Hog, Lorang, Clang.
party: Kerning PQ: level 21+, 30 minutes. Stages 2 to 4 need three members on the right spots while the leader talks to Cloto, so bring four.
Party EXP: each kill's EXP is divided among the party. The wiki lists no party bonus.

upcoming.note: Nexon says it opens in November; no exact date yet. New monsters in the game files include Glowshrooms, Raffles and Golden Stirges.
